name: DCX Mesh Extraction via UDF and Marching Cubes
definition: Extracts a triangular mesh from a BVH structure by computing an Unsigned Distance Field (UDF) on a grid, converting it to a Signed Distance Field (SDF) using flood fill, and applying Marching Cubes.
summary: DCX Mesh Extraction via UDF and Marching Cubes converts BVH unsigned distance fields to signed distance fields using flood fill before generating triangular meshes.
